title: 第83章 送梦倩回家

第83章 送梦倩回家-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

“你家孙子长个子关我什么事情，那是你孙子，又不是我和你儿媳妇生的儿子，跟我有什么关系？”

“平白无故想要吃肉，你咋不把你儿媳妇借给我补一补身子？”

李青山顿时不爽道。

“李青山，你这是说的什么话，我家儿媳妇凭什么借给你玩，而且你这肉给一个寡妇吃，凭什么不能给我家孙子吃？”

“我家孙子出生的时候，可是有算命先生说了，这是富贵命，以后可是有大出息的，还是什么金童玉女，你今天要是把肉给我家孙子吃了，就是结下善缘，以后我家孙子要是当了大官，随便拉你一下，照顾你一下，就够你受用一生了。”

麻子婶一副得意的模样道。

“麻子婶，你家孙子要是富贵命，怎么你家吃不上肉？”李青山笑着道。

“吃不上……这……这可能是时候没到吧！”麻子婶顿时被噎住了，有些难受道。

“麻子婶，有没有可能是算命先生看你家孙子富贵命眼红，把你家泥鳅得富贵命的命格给偷走了？我看啊，你得去找算命的去问问。”

李青山心念一转，开口道。

“啪！”

“对啊！”

麻子婶顿时一拍大腿道：“我怎么就没想到呢，我家孙子富贵命别人肯定会眼红，这该死的刘瞎子，我这就去找他的。”

李青山望着麻子婶远去的背影，忍不住笑出声来。

恶人自有恶人磨。

就让麻子婶去和那骗子好好过过招吧，李青山估计，最后麻子婶还得被算命的忽悠。

“李青山，你不会和柔雪那寡妇勾搭一块去了吧，连肉都舍得送过去？”村里的懒汉赵铁蛋挑刺道。

顿时。

周围的几个村民，目光纷纷朝着李青山望了过来，这说的不是没有道理，平白无故的给人送肉干什么？

这可是肉啊！

大家逢年过节都吃不上几块的肉，竟然就这么送给一个寡妇吃？

“呵呵！”

“别说送肉了，前几日我还给柔雪送了新衣裳呢，至于为什么要给柔雪送肉送新衣裳，那是因为人要懂得知恩图报。”

“我那猎枪，可不是白捡到的。”

“对了，今天我李青山在这里说一声，以后柔雪就是我李青山罩着的女人了，谁敢对柔雪动什么歪心思，花花肠子，别怪我李青山不客气。”

说罢。

李青山便不再管村民的反应，端着陶土盆一路到了柔雪的家里。

破旧的土坯房子，已经年久失修，稍微有些大雨落下来的话，估计就要漏雨，请人修补要花钱的，柔雪便只能自己一个人稍微修补一下，但是一个女人哪里会干这些活，修补的手艺不太好，下雨估计还会漏。

"What does your grandson's growth have to do with me? That's your grandson, not the son I had with your daughter-in-law. What does it have to do with me?"

"You want to eat meat for no reason, why don't you lend me your daughter-in-law to replenish your health?"

Li Qingshan suddenly felt unhappy.

"Li Qingshan, what are you talking about? Why did my daughter-in-law lend it to you to play with? And if your meat is given to a widow, why can't it be given to my grandson?"

"When my grandson was born, a fortune teller said that he would be rich and prosperous, and that he would have a great future in the future, and he would be a golden boy. If you give meat to my grandson today, you will form a good relationship. If my grandson becomes a high official in the future, he can help you and take care of you, and it will be enough for you for the rest of his life."

Aunt Mazi said with a proud look.

"Aunt Mazi, if your grandson is rich and prosperous, why can't your family eat meat?" Li Qingshan said with a smile.

"I can't eat... this... maybe it's not the right time!" Aunt Mazi suddenly choked and said a little uncomfortable.

"Aunt Mazi, is it possible that the fortune teller was jealous of your grandson's wealth and fortune and stole the fortune of your grandson? I think you have to go find the fortune teller to ask."

Li Qingshan changed his mind and said.

"Crack!"

"Yes!"

Aunt Mazi immediately slapped her thigh and said, "Why didn't I think of that? Others will be jealous if my grandson is rich and noble. This damn blind man Liu, I'm going to find him right now."

Li Qingshan looked at Aunt Mazi's retreating back and couldn't help laughing.

Evil people will be punished by evil people.

Let Aunt Mazi go and have a good fight with the liar. Li Qingshan estimated that Aunt Mazi would have to be deceived by the fortune teller in the end.

"Li Qingshan, you're not going to hook up with that widow Rouxue, are you even willing to give away meat?" Zhao Tiedan, a lazy man in the village, said sarcastically.

Suddenly.

Several villagers around him looked at Li Qingshan. This was not unreasonable. Why would he give meat to people for no reason?

This is meat!

Everyone can't afford a few pieces of meat during the holidays, so they just give it to a widow?

"Haha!"

"Not to mention giving meat, I gave Rouxue new clothes a few days ago. As for why I gave Rouxue meat and new clothes, it's because people need to know how to repay kindness."

"I didn't find that shotgun for nothing."

"By the way, today I, Li Qingshan, will say something here. From now on, Rouxue will be the woman that I, Li Qingshan, will protect. Who dares to have any twisted thoughts or tricks towards Rouxue? Don't blame me, Li Qingshan, for being rude."

Say it.

Li Qingshan no longer cared about the villagers' reactions and carried the clay basin all the way to Rouxue's home.

The dilapidated adobe house has been in disrepair for a long time. If there is a little heavy rain, it will probably leak. It will cost money to hire someone to repair it. Rouxue can only do a little repair by herself, but how can a woman do such work? The repairing skills are not very good, and it is likely to leak even if it rains.
